title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: J.K. Dobbins (hamstring) to practice this week
items.desc: Broncos RB J.K. Dobbins is expected to practice this week.
items.impact: Dobbins receive good news on the hamstring injury he suffered. The entire Broncos backfield is banged up with RJ Harvey and Jonah Coleman also battling injuries.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonah Coleman suffers ankle sprain
items.desc: Broncos RB Jonah Coleman is dealing with a sprained ankle that he suffered in Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: The Broncos backfield suffers another injury with JK Dobbins an RJ Harvey also banged up. Coleman's status is up in the air for Week 3.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling signing with Chargers 53-man roster
items.desc: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said they're signing WR Marquez Valdes-Scantling to the 53-man roster.
items.impact: Valdes-Scantling will hold a depth role. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charlie Kolar (arm) won't go on injured reserve, out for Week 3
items.desc: Charlie Kolar (arm) won't land on injured reserve but is going to be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: The Chargers were initially planning on placing Kolar on injured reserve, but after the procedure on his arm, they feel confident that he won't miss four or more weeks and are opting to keep him on the active roster. He is not going to play in Week 3, but he should be back sometime within the next few weeks, which is less than ideal for the fantasy value of Oronde Gadsden II.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) will practice Wednesday
items.desc: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak reiterated that Brock Bowers will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kubiak said Bowers will be evaluated "day to day." His status remains uncertain for Week 3.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (hamstring) week-to-week
items.desc: Bears CB Tyrique Stevenson is week-to-week with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Stevenson will likely miss Monday's game against the Eagles.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) not seen practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Nico Collins was not seen practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Collins was absent last week with a hamstring injury. He remains uncertain heading into Week 3.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said Rueben Bain Jr. is not practicing on Wednesday due to a groin injury.
items.impact: Bain picked up the injury in last Sunday's game. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Mahogany (hip) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Mahogany returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mahogany was ruled out last week. With a few extra days off, he'll have a chance to return this weekend.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Blake Miller (knee) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Blake Miller returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Miller was ruled out last week. With a few extra days off, he'll have a chance to return this weekend.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cal Adomitis signs with Saints active roster
items.desc: The Saints signed Cal Adomitis to their active roster.
items.impact: Adomitis gets the opportunity with Kelvin Banks Jr. placed on IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrei Iosivas (thumb) placed on IR
items.desc: Bengals WR Andrei Iosivas tore a ligament in his thumb and will go on IR.
items.impact: Iosivas will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo remained absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Okonkwo did not play last week. His status remains up in the air heading into Week 3.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The Saints placed OT Kelvin Banks Jr. on injured reserve.
items.impact: Banks is expected to undergo surgery for an ankle sprain he suffered. He will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Flowers continues to work his way back from a hamstring injury. His status remains uncertain for Week 3.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Starling Thomas V added to Cardinals active roster
items.desc: The Cardinals added CB Starling Thomas V to their active roster.
items.impact: Thomas was brought up from the practice squad with Will Johnson (neck) placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Johnson (neck) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed CB Will Johnson on injured reserve.
items.impact: Johnson is expected to miss the rest of the season with a neck injury he suffered.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Burrow dealing with soreness
items.desc: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Joe Burrow is dealing with soreness.
items.impact: It is unclear how much Burrow will practice on Wednesday. He is day-to-day for now.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) is not taking part at New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Fitzpatrick is not practicing for the Jets on Wednesday. This isn't surprising, considering that his original injury timeline indicates that he's likely to miss another week of action at least. New York's secondary will be considerably weaker for as long as he remains out of the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Bailey (elbow) set to practice Wednesday
items.desc: David Bailey (elbow) is set to practice in a limited capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bailey is set to practice on Wednesday, despite recently suffering an elbow injury of some kind. It looks like he is trending towards playing this week, which is good for New York's defensive front ahead of a tough matchup against the Lions.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Wright (stinger) to be limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylen Wright will be limited for Wednesday's practice.
items.impact: Wright's status is up in the air heading into Week 3.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joseph Ossai (foot) to be limited Wednesday
items.desc: Joseph Ossai (foot) is set to be a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ossai is going to be a limited participant at Wednesday's practice, which is a good sign considering that he has missed time due to this injury. His return would be good news for a New York defensive front that is dealing with multiple injuries to starters right now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Warren not seen practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren was not seen practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is unclear what Warren is dealing with. Rico Dowdle also did not practice and was seen in a boot on his right foot.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) in boot Wednesday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle was wearing a boot on his right foot during practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dowdle left last week's game early with what was reported as a toe injury. He remains day-to-day.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) won't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mason Taylor (thumb) won't take part in New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young tight end is not going to take part in the team's practice on Wednesday. He recently suffered a thumb injury and is now considered week-to-week. It looks like he's trending towards being sidelined in Week 3, which would open the door for rookie Kenyon Sadiq to see more work in his absence.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chop Robinson (concussion) will practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Chop Robinson will practice Wednesday.
items.impact: Robinson continues to advance through concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Cosmi placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: The Commanders placed RG Sam Cosmi in concussion protocol.
items.impact: Cosmi is up in the air for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Cross ruled out for Week 3
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Nick Cross has been ruled out  Sunday because of an internal injury.
items.impact: Cross had been hospitalized after last week's game. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kene Nwangwu (back) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Kene Nwangwu (back) is not taking part in New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: To no surprise, the veteran running back is not practicing on Wednesday after missing the first two games of the season due to a back issue. It looks like he's trending towards missing another game, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) seeing specialist Wednesday
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Jayden Daniels is seeing a specialist on Wednesday.
items.impact: Quinn did not have an update on Daniels. There should be an update later this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) won't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Caleb Douglas (ankle) won't take part in Miami's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie recently suffered an ankle injury and will not be able to practice on Wednesday because of it. That's not a good sign for his availability for Week 3, but fantasy managers should continue to keep tabs on updates about his health throughout the week to see whether or not he will suit up against the Chiefs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Arian Smith underwent ACL surgery, out for season
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Arian Smith had ACL surgery and is out for the year.
items.impact: Smith suffered a torn ACL. He was placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Onyemata (groin) expected to return by the end of the season
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said the team expects David Onyemata to return by the end of the season.
items.impact: Onyemata was placed on injured reserve. He had core-muscle surgery.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyjae Spears not practicing Wednesday due to soreness
items.desc: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Tyjae Spears will not practice on Wednesday due to soreness.
items.impact: Spears and Tony Pollard both aren't practicing due to what is being described as "soreness". They'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Pollard not practicing Wednesday due to soreness
items.desc: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Tony Pollard will not practice on Wednesday due to soreness.
items.impact: Pollard and Tyjae Spears both aren't practicing due to what is being described as "soreness". They'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Robert Longerbeam signs with Falcons
items.desc: Robert Longerbeam has agreed to a contract with the Falcons.
items.impact: The Falcons are bringing Longerbeam in off the Eagles' practice squad and adding him to their active roster. With A.J. Terrell landing on IR, the Falcons are in need of depth at defensive back. Longerbeam was a sixth-round draft pick of the Ravens in 2025, but he has yet to play in an NFL regular-season game.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jaxson Dart (knee) to miss the rest of the season
items.desc: Jaxson Dart (knee) will undergo season-ending surgery.
items.impact: Dart had been getting multiple opinions on his ACL injury. Examination shows that the ligament is intact, but Dart will still require surgery that will end his second-season. Jameis Winston will take over as QB1 for the Giants.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) to get in some work Wednesday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) will get in some work during Wednesday's practice session.
items.impact: After making three grabs for 58 yards in Week 1, Pittman missed Week 2's loss to the Patriots due to a foot injury. He should still be viewed as questionable for this Sunday, but Pittman is at least moving in the right direction. Germie Bernard saw an uptick in playing time with Pittman sidelined.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) to be placed on IR
items.desc: Alec Pierce (heel) will be placed on IR and has no projected timetable for recovery.
items.impact: This was an expected move by the Colts. Pierce is attempting to rehab his heel injury instead of undergoing surgery. The big-play wide receiver will miss at least four weeks, and probably longer. Veteran receiver Darius Slayton was signed by the Colts earier this week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) to be backup QB on Thursday
items.desc: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) will be the Falcons' No. 2 quarterback for Thursday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Tagovailoa was expected to enter the season as the Falcons' starting QB, but an oblique injury knocked him out of the first two games. Michael Penix is now ready to return as the top quarterback for Thursday's game. Tagovailoa will be the backup for Penix.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (core) officially on IR
items.desc: Jonathon Brooks (core) was officially placed on IR on Wednesday.
items.impact: Brooks had core muscle surgery on Wednesday and will be out for at least four weeks on IR. The 23-year-old's timetable is actually projected to be around six weeks. Chuba Hubbard will continue to shoulder the load ouf of the backfield for the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ollie Gordon II uninvolved in loss Sunday
items.desc: Ollie Gordon II rushed the ball three times for seven yards in Sunday's 35-13 loss to the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Gordon didn't play much on Sunday, seeing just three touches in Miami's three-score loss to the 49ers. He hasn't shown much involvement at all over the first two weeks of the season, so fantasy managers shouldn't consider rostering him for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kendrick Bourne quiet in loss Sunday
items.desc: Kendrick Bourne caught 2-of-3 targets for just 11 yards in Sunday's 31-7 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Bourne came back down to earth in Week 2 after a stellar performance in Arizona's season opener a week before. He only caught two passes for 11 yards on Sunday, but Arizona's offense as a whole struggled in this matchup against Seattle, so there's a good chance that he will bounce back and have relevance as a depth piece in most leagues sometime in the near future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. underwhelming in win Sunday
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. rushed the ball eight times for 25 yards and caught two passes for six yards in Sunday's 24-17 win over the Baltimore Ravems.
items.impact: Week 2 exposed some major concerns for Etienne. Not only did he have a bad game as far as efficiency and fantasy output go, but the return of Alvin Kamara is proving to be a big issue for his fantasy value, as the 31-year old saw one more carry and four more targets in his first game back from injury. Unless this distribution of work changes in the near future, it looks like Etienne is going to have a volatile week-to-week ceiling with the presence of Kamara eating into his workload that much.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Micheal Clemons (toe) lands on IR
items.desc: Micheal Clemons (toe) was placed on IR by the Colts on Tuesday.
items.impact: Clemons sustained a toe injury in Monday night's game against the Chiefs. He will now have to miss at least the next four weeks. Clemons was signed to a three-year deal back in March after spending his first four NFL seasons with the Jets. Rookie Caden Curry could be in line for more playing time.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Austin Ekeler working out with Carolina on Wednesday
items.desc: Austin Ekeler is working out for the Carolina Panthers on Wednesday. This news comes alongside of Jonathon Brooks missing the next month and a half due to surgery.
items.impact: Panthers starter Chuba Hubbard is not a pass catching specialist, and Ekeler was one of the best pass catching running backs in the business for a time, making this potential pairing intriguing. Ekeler has been cleared for football activities after recovering from a torn Achilles he suffered last season, but it will be interesting to see what sort of shape he's currently in. Chuba should still retain the majority of the volume, but Ekeler could be an interesting flex play in PPR formats should he make the team.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hayden Rucci signed by Chargers
items.desc: The Chargers signed TE Hayden Rucci off the Jaguars' practice squad.
items.impact: Rucci is a depth addition for the Chargers with David Njoku and Charlie Kolar placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Onwenu (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The Patriots placed Mike Onwenu on injured reserve.
items.impact: Onwenu went down this past Sunday against the Steelers. He will miss at least four games.
